description:
Auto Outfitting
Optimal autofit for Starsector 0.98a+0.98.5a.

Download | Source code and guides
Required mods: None. LunaLib is optional and adds a settings menu (F3).
Updating: Delete the old Auto Outfitting folder in mods/, then extract the new one. Or use TriOS.
Saves: Safe to add or remove mid-game.

What it does

Optimal autofit: Adds an Optimal option to the refit screen's Autofit list. It builds the strongest loadout it can from the weapons, fighters and hullmods you have in cargo and storage, and from the market if you allow it.
Scoring: Weapons and hullmods are picked on combat numbers and on how the game's AI flies the ship. The officer's skills, d-mods and CR count.
Optimize fleet: Fits every ship in the fleet at once from one shared stock, biggest ships first.
Order fleet weapons: Orders the weapons and fighters the fleet plan is missing through custom production.
Fleet analysis: Shows the fleet's damage mix, fighter roles and weak spots.
Civilian ships: Freighters, tankers and salvage ships get campaign hullmods and no weapons.
S-mods: Only built in when Build in s-mods is ticked in the Autofit panel. Keeps 3 story points by default.
Lock this ship: Keeps a ship out of Optimize fleet and Order fleet weapons.

Getting started

Open the refit screen and pick a ship.
Press Autofit, then click Optimal.
Press Confirm to keep it.

Compatibility

Other mods: Weapons, fighters and hullmods from any mod are rated from their stats.
Ship Mastery System: Turn off its "S-mod autofit option" in LunaLib, or its autofit replaces Optimal.
Bugs: Post here or open a GitHub issue with starsector-core/starsector.log and your modlist.

Permissions: Free to use, change and reupload, in modpacks too. No credit needed. Do not sell it.

AI use disclaimer

Design and in-game testing: Mjolniar.
Training data: None added. Art: None.
